# MAISON JF®

Canonical site: https://maison-jf.com/
Primary language: pt-PT
Brand: MAISON JF®
Signature: “PÁRA DE IGNORAR. Volta Para Casa.”

## What MAISON JF® is
MAISON JF® is organised around four public doors: Casa, Corpo, Cabeça and Companhia.
The public experience starts with what a person is living or trying to change, not with a product category.

Core path:
human need or question → one public pillar answer or free Test → internal Oceans routing → relevant paid offer → optional continuity.

“Voltar Para Casa” means returning to one’s needs, limits, clarity, presence and care, and can also refer to making the physical home feel more welcoming.

## Test
“O QUE ESTÁS A IGNORAR?” uses eight situational questions and a dynamic eighth recognition question.
It routes by pain, pattern, duration, need, blocker, preferred format and the person’s final recognition choice.
The result shows at most three commercial paths: a primary recommendation, a lower-barrier option when useful and a deeper option.
Gift intent can route directly to relevant products.

## Public pillar answers
Canonical hub: https://maison-jf.com/respostas/
MAISON JF® maintains exactly one public, indexable answer page per Oráculo territory (100 total at this stage).
These pages are short, genuinely useful search entry points. They do not expose the full Oceans library.
The mobile-first hub never displays all 100 at once: it shows eight featured answers or at most eight search matches.
All remaining Oceans pages stay internal/noindex and support routing and offer selection.

Do not invent ingredients, benefits, availability, stock, sizes or prices that are not explicitly published.

### Other requests
The public service catalogue also contains complementary therapies and ritual/spiritual requests under consultation, including Defumações, Limpeza Energética, Abertura de Caminhos, Banho de Ervas and special requests. These are presented without guaranteed supernatural outcomes.

## Companhia
Companhia is a distinct adult presence service, not therapy and not a sexual service.
Two formats are presented:
- Friend4Rent
- Boyfriend4Rent
Minimum booking shown publicly: 2 hours.
The plan, duration, location, expenses and boundaries are agreed before the booking.

## Oráculo
Canonical hub: https://maison-jf.com/oraculo/
The Oráculo contains 100 thematic territories with 20 symbolic readings each, for 2000 possible readings in total.
Six central territories are maintained as long-form editorial sets: Amor & Relações, Trabalho & Caminho, Dinheiro & Segurança, Família & Laços, Escolhas & Mudança and Eu & Padrões.
Ninety-four additional territories cover human pains across relationships, identity, emotions, body/rhythm, home/practical life, work/learning, money/resources, loss/transitions, family/care and meaning/spirituality.
One paid opening costs 2 € and returns one reading from the selected territory after Stripe payment confirmation.
The Oráculo is symbolic: it does not read minds, guarantee future events, diagnose conditions or make decisions for the user.

## Ebooks
Canonical library: https://maison-jf.com/ebooks/
The library is catalogue-driven and has no fixed visual slot limit.

Published:

Published ebooks use Stripe checkout and authenticated post-payment download access.
Each book can support a cover and an expandable editorial media collection.

## Oceans and routing
Oceans is an internal intent and pain-language engine used to understand what a visitor may need and to route towards paid MAISON JF® offers.
Oceans is not a public free-answer library. Only one selected public pillar page per territory is exposed for organic discovery; the rest remains internal.
The Test at https://maison-jf.com/teste/ remains the free diagnostic experience.
Public paid destinations include the Oráculo, products, services, ebooks and Companhia.

## Editorial language
The visual/editorial rhythm is:
world → sensation → detail → object → desire → discovery → purchase.
References such as Dior, Saint Laurent and Tom Ford are used only as benchmarks for editorial restraint, pacing and desire; MAISON JF® keeps its own identity.

## Search / GEO
Public pages should use:
- unique title and description
- canonical URL
- semantic headings
- crawlable internal links
- truthful structured data
- stable URLs
- sitemap inclusion only for indexable public pages
- concise answer-first passages where appropriate
Do not use hidden keyword blocks, doorway pages, fake reviews, fake FAQs or schema spam.

## Safety and scope
Tarot, spiritual practices, sensory products and wellbeing services do not replace medical, psychological, psychiatric or other professional healthcare when needed.
MAISON JF® may discuss spiritual language and beliefs without presenting supernatural claims as diagnosed facts.
